instruction: Create `/home/user/Desktop/qfn8.lbr`, an EAGLE library containing exactly one package, and save it. Requirements: 1. The file must parse as XML. 2. The library must contain exactly 1 `<package>`. 3. That package must contain exactly 8 `<smd>` pads. 4. The pad names must be `1` through `8`. 5. The package must contain at least one `<wire>` or `<polygon>` on layer `21`. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
